# v0.4.0 規則準備紀錄／Rule preparation record

## 繁體中文

### 版本與範圍

本紀錄依 [版本方式](../../CHANGELOG.md) 準備下一 minor `v0.4.0`，新增 [#23 必要 reviewer 有效唯讀條件](../../contracts/review-and-security.md#review-required-read-only)與 [#22 公開操作資料檢查](../../contracts/review-and-security.md#review-publication-data)。它是來源候選準備，不能證明已合併、正式採納、tag／Release 發布或 consumer 安裝。準備時查讀的正式 v0.3.0 Release 指向 `7efe4eea59031ed5f9ff9c4a8aef5b8f7d2be02e`，未讀到 v0.4 tag；正式操作前仍須重查名稱與目標，不覆寫既有 tag 或公開歷史。

#23 限制所有計入必要 review 的路徑對受審內容及任務明定資源的有效寫入，不採用仍可寫的替代者；核對當次相關工具／控制與實際暴露通道，缺條件只停止相依 gate。它保留 shared parent sandbox、正常流程及任務範圍，不新增全主機／惡意管理員防護要求。資格不代替實際當前 review，文字測試不建立控制。

#22 在每次相關操作前要求有界資料檢查，涵蓋內容、必要 raw metadata、完整 commit range、merge／squash 預期結果、commit／tag 簽章公開資料及實際目的地。Commit 建立前核對預定公開資料，建立後在相依發布前讀回實際物件；不讀取簽署秘密，不用公開後讀回倒證事前缺口，不把有界檢查當完整秘密偵測或每次必跑正式 Security Diff Scan。

詳細需求、風險、早期 findings 與有限案例範圍見 [上游候選工作包](../maintenance/issue-22-23-upstream-candidate.md)。本包只在 review-and-security 增加完整句子；其餘三契約、LICENSE、完整 notices、先前 release notes 及全部舊字行序／mode 保留。先前伴讀及雙端 gate 記錄保留歷史，新順序另加明確範圍說明，不把當時未執行改為通過。

上述有效唯讀是預設；後續使用者要求的具體例外，允許必要用途使寫入通道無法移除時，對特定環境一次性接受殘餘風險並記錄通道、理由、替代偵測及未涵蓋範圍。同環境及規則未變可重用接受，改變須重新接受；偵測受審內容改動使該次審查作廢，不把接受或未見差異當作技術禁寫或完整偵測。此新候選須重新完成相關案例、深入／完整安全評估及正式掃描，舊結果不倒記覆蓋例外；Claude 的接受紀錄仍為使用者表示將補、未驗完成。

使用者後續已授權本次擴充候選 commit、非破壞性 push、更新現有 draft PR31 及新版本完整 Merge Review；實際授權來源是該決定，不是版本準備文字，不包含 merge、正式 tag／Release 或代接口接受環境風險。

### 上游與下游的不同完成條件

使用者已將本次 #22／#23 的順序改為 Core 先完成自身必要評估、測試與審查，再決定採納和發布，不等待 Codex／Grok 候選 pin／eval。Codex 後續採用自行驗證；Grok 驗證、修改、發行／部署等使用者另行通知。兩端對本版的相容性目前未驗證，Grok 相容性未知，不能從 Core 文件、前版案例或 Codex #370／#368 推定通過。

Core 自身驗收涵蓋固定來源、需求與規則一致性、原字保留及破壞負例、二十六檔完整清冊與引用、有限合成契約判讀、保密檢查、必要獨立深入內容／安全審查及正式安全差異掃描。正式檢查結果另綁定 exact revision／diff，不由此準備紀錄自我宣告 PASS；每個公開 PR 新 HEAD 仍須完整 Merge Review。未配置／未跑 CI 不記為通過。

### 發布與採用交接

Core 的來源版本由 CHANGELOG 條目記錄，沒有 catalog、VERSION 或 installer。新增此發行紀錄及上游候選工作包後，完整預期集合為二十五份 Markdown 與 LICENSE；最終須逐檔查 raw bytes、mode、完整相對引用及 notices，而非沿用 v0.3.0 或 PR31 的舊集合 digest。

正式合併、annotated tag 與 GitHub Release 各需具體操作授權；候選準備不自動授權它們。取得授權後，先查精確 repo／HEAD、tag／Release 衝突與 payload，發布後讀回 tag object、解析後完整 commit、Release 目標及 draft／prerelease 狀態，才能聲稱正式版本已發布。最終公開內容身分與逐檔／集合 digest 放在當次 tag annotation／Release 交接，不在追蹤文件內嵌自身 commit 或 digest。

Consumer 在自己的後續工作包核對正式來源、完整 immutable revision、清冊、每檔／集合 digest、allowlist、引用閉包、完整 notices、組裝與適用相容性驗證。Core 不自動更新 consumer 或現有安裝，不反向依賴其實作進度，也不以本版發行宣稱所有 runtime 合格。來源 permalink 是出處，不是新增執行依賴；README 連到準備記錄及發布查核方法，不維護 mutable latest。

## English

### Version and scope

Prepare minor v0.4.0 under CHANGELOG for #23 required-reviewer effective-read-only conditions and #22 per-operation publication-data inspection. This source-candidate record proves neither merge/adoption nor tag/Release publication or consumer installation. During preparation, the published v0.3.0 Release resolved to `7efe4eea59031ed5f9ff9c4a8aef5b8f7d2be02e`; no v0.4 tag was returned. Recheck exact names/targets before authorized publication; overwrite no tag or public history.

The reviewer addition covers every credited required-review route, protected task resources, actual relevant controls/exposed channels, incomplete review and dependent stops. It retains inherited parent sandboxes and bounded normal workflows without whole-host or hostile-administrator defense. Qualification still requires actual current review; text tests do not enforce controls.

Publication inspection covers intended content, necessary raw metadata, full commit ranges, prospective merge/squash results, commit/tag public signature data and real destinations before each relevant operation. Inspect intended public commit data before creation and actual objects before dependent publication. Access no signing secrets. Post-publication readback cannot prove an earlier missing check; bounded inspection is neither a complete detector nor an automatic full formal scan for every action.

The upstream packet records requirements, early findings, risks and finite cases. Add complete sentences only to review-and-security; retain every earlier word/line/mode, the other three contracts, LICENSE, complete notices and historical releases. Preserve earlier companion/dual-gate history and separately qualify the new timing without relabeling old unrun checks as passed.

Effective read-only operation remains the default. The user's later exception permits one-time acceptance of necessary retained channels for a specific environment, recording channels, reasons, alternative detection and gaps. Unchanged environments/rules need no repeated confirmation; changes require renewed acceptance. Detected reviewed-content modification invalidates the review. Acceptance or unchanged fingerprints establishes neither technical denial nor complete detection. Fresh cases and full deep/security review and formal scanning must cover the new candidate; old results do not. Claude's announced acceptance remains unverified here.

The user later authorized this expanded candidate's commit, non-destructive push, existing draft PR31 update and complete new-version Merge Review. That decision supplies authority; preparation text does not. Merge, official tag/Release and accepting an interface environment's risk on its behalf remain excluded.

### Acceptance, publication and adoption

For this #22/#23 work, the user now permits Core's own required evaluation, testing and review before adoption/publication without waiting for consumer pins/evals. Codex verifies later adoption; Grok validation/changes/release/deployment await further instruction. Both consumers' compatibility with this version is unverified; Grok compatibility is unknown. Neither earlier cases nor #370/#368 qualify it.

Core acceptance covers fixed sources, requirement/contract coherence, raw preservation/corruption negatives, the full 26-file inventory/reference closure, synthetic normative decisions, privacy, independent deep content/security review and formal Security Diff Scan. Bind actual outcomes separately to exact content; this record grants no PASS. Each new public head still needs full Merge Review. Missing/unrun CI is not passed.

CHANGELOG records Core's source document version; there is no catalog, VERSION or installer. The full expected set is 25 Markdown files plus LICENSE. Verify actual bytes/modes/references/notices; old v0.3.0/PR31 digests do not identify it. Merge, annotated tag and GitHub Release each retain separate explicit authority. Precheck exact repo/HEAD, conflicts and payload, then read back tag object, resolved commit, Release target and draft/prerelease states before claiming publication. Final identities/digests belong in the authorized publication handoff, avoiding self-reference in tracked text.

Consumers independently verify fixed formal source, inventory, per-file/set digests, allowlists, closure, notices, assembly and compatibility. Core updates neither consumers nor installations automatically and does not depend on their implementation completion. Publication qualifies no runtime. Source permalinks are provenance, not execution dependencies; stable README guidance points to preparation and publication checks rather than a mutable latest state. Written per ASD-STE100 principles; full conformance is unverified.
